title: decently decent
text: decently decent. they r nice looking tables... not really great instructions.. u kinda have to figure it out on your own... just find 4 like legs two times.. and the 4 left over make the other table.. got 3 stars.. because.. 4 screws were missing.. luckily I had a few in the basement I could make work... also one on the corners was completely bent and I had to bandaid it myself and made it work... looks nice but that one corner i have to keep hidden.  3 stars because for this price I was expecting better quality... and I wouldve returned.. but seems like such a hassle so I'll just settle for it....
